An unfinished masterwork magic draft for the gloves must first be created at the pattern table, consuming all of the items, after which it can be worked on using the tailoring process to create it. Crafting this item requires a total of 25,000 progress; 7,500 at the drafting table and 17,500 at the tailor's dummy (as an unfinished masterwork magic gloves). At the default rate of 20 progress every 4 ticks (2.4 seconds), this takes 5000 ticks, or 50 minutes. This time may be increased or decreased by interacting with focus windows.
